resolutions.researcher_notes: Searched for a source stating the SegmentCost of $60,000,000 USD for the Hillabee Expansion Project, Phase 2 (SheetRow 1311). Opened and read to exhaustion every doc already on this row (Williams' 5/1/2020 'Phase II ... Now in Service' press release + its Business Wire original, the Williams 10-Q at sec.gov/.../wmb2019063010q.htm, the nsenergybusiness.com project page, the govinfo.gov FR-2014-12-11 notice, industrialinfo.com's 'Williams Moves on Transco Expansions' article) plus new sources: OGJ 'Construction nears for Hillabee expansion project', World Pipelines' Hillabee construction-start piece, industrialinfo.com's 'Williams Progresses with Transco Expansion Projects' and 'Williams to Complete Six Key Natural Gas Pipeline Projects in 2017', the Transco (CIK 99250) standalone 10-Q for Q1 2018, and the Feb-2018 FERC remand order for the SMP Project (Sabal Trail + Hillabee + FSC) via climatepolicyradar's cached PDF. None state a dollar figure for Hillabee Phase 2 specifically. Phase-2-specific facts found: ~11 miles of pipeline looping + a new compressor at Station 95 + modifications at Station 100, capacity +206,660 Dth/d, in service 5/1/2020 -- no cost. Cost figures that DO exist for this project are not phase-2-specific or don't match: (1) industrialinfo.com 'Williams Moves on Transco Expansions Despite Headwinds' states the Hillabee project overall (all 3 phases combined) carries an estimated total investment value (TIV) of $380 million -- not phase-broken-out, so not usable for a Phase-2-only SegmentCost. (2) A Williams/Williams Partners investor-presentation exhibit filed with the SEC 1/9/2017 (8-K, EX-99.2, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/107263/000119312517005707/d286166dex992.htm) has a chart crosstab of Transco growth projects showing 'Hillabee (Ph. 2) $119' under a 'Capital' column (with EBITDA $19.2M and ROIC ~16.1%% for the same row, consistent with each other) -- this is ~2x the recorded $60,000,000 and is FLAGGED AS A CONTRADICTION, not cited as a ref: it long predates Phase 2's 2020 completion (so may be a 2017-vintage forecast/partial-year capex rather than final total cost), the figure is extracted from a scanned/embedded chart table rather than prose, and its cost basis (total project capital vs. a single year's spend) is not stated in the document -- too ambiguous to safely corroborate or overwrite the sheet value. Not citing it. No independent source was found that agrees (within rounding or otherwise) with $60,000,000 for Phase 2 specifically. Tried url_verifier-clean candidates only; found none to submit. Recommend Update leg pull FERC docket CP15-16/CP15-17 resource reports (Transco's original Section 7 application filings, which typically itemize per-phase facility costs) or a Williams 10-K capital-projects table for the fiscal year Phase 2 was completed (2020) as the next places to look.
